title: VFX tileable noise
description: Seamless grayscale noise texture, tileable on both axes, for effect masks, distortion and dissolve.

guidance: Name the noise type (for example soft cloud noise, cellular noise, wispy smoke, turbulent fluid) and its feature scale.
Ask for a grayscale, seamless, tileable-on-both-axes, top-down texture whose values fill the frame from black to white.
No objects, no perspective, no vignetting, no colour tint, no baked light direction.
The noise fills the whole frame, so the image has no separate background.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear noise type and its role in an effect (mask, distortion or dissolve).
The prompt asks for a grayscale texture that is seamless on both axes and fills the frame evenly.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example seamless tiling and a single focal object or a vignette).
The prompt asks for an opaque image with no transparency.
image_rubric: The image shows the noise the prompt asked for, without objects or extra subjects.
The image is grayscale, with no colour tint.
No visible seam or repeating focal feature when tiled 2x2.
Coverage is even; no vignette, gradient or large empty area.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.

constraints.background: Opaque; the noise fills the whole frame on a pure-black (#000000) base, darkest values black.
constraints.lighting: Even coverage with no baked light direction and no vignette.
constraints.processing: Alpha extraction, channel packing and power-of-two resize are not asset-gen's job. The gen-run binds the output hashes and the image service ignores the requested size, so those transforms belong to the consuming package's import tool.
